name: model-runner-5a3112fd-blind30-ots
instr:
# docker/model-runner: wrong answers and outright failures across the CLI and server, without a test suite

Several unrelated things in this build now answer wrongly or fail outright, and the failures are spread thinly across everything a user touches. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

Getting hold of a model from somewhere else has gone wrong in several ways. Looking for one by keyword against the hosted catalogue comes back with the wrong engine label on every hit: when the follow-up query that works out which engine serves a repository fails, the hit is not reported as unknown, and when that same query succeeds, the engine it found is not the label that ends up in the result either. Resolving a tag against a registry that answers with an authentication challenge whose token endpoint is a loopback address is no longer refused before anything goes over the network; a request really is sent to that address, and the failure handed back quotes the reply body from it rather than saying the realm URL was rejected, so whatever that endpoint printed is visible in the error text. Three independent problems turn up while working out which user name and secret to present to a registry. When the pair is held inline as a single base64 blob in the on-disk settings, the decoded user name and secret are not the ones that were written there.
